notes: Fieldwork — a complete local-first research workspace in vanilla JavaScript (HTML + CSS + classic JS, no frameworks, no build step, zero runtime dependencies; works from file:// or any static server). Invented product 'Fieldwork' for researchers/students. Features: multiple views (dashboard, projects, project workspace with Sources/Notes tabs, source detail with excerpts, note detail, global tags, global search, settings); real workflows (create project → add sources → capture excerpts → write/link notes → tag → search → export); structured data model (Project/Source/Excerpt/Note) with referential-integrity cleanup; client-side validation with accessible inline errors; duplicate detection (project names, sources, tags); robust persistence in localStorage with safe in-memory fallback when storage is unavailable or full, corrupted-data recovery with backup, and cross-tab sync; JSON export/import backup with validation and duplicate-safe merge or replace plus replace confirmation; empty states; responsive + keyboard-accessible (semantic HTML, focus management, focus-trapped modal, skip link, ARIA live regions, Esc, '/' shortcut); light/dark/system theme; error boundaries. Local-only disclosure: no backend/server, no network, no real-time collaboration or sharing, no cloud sync; data lives in this browser and portability is via JSON file/clipboard. Honest testing: verified with automated checks; see test status in the task report. No known incomplete features; minor: note bodies are plain text (no rich text); import accepts Fieldwork JSON only.
